'''2007 Worlds Day 2 Greg Shaw LS Plead My Case To The Senate''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Greg Shaw]] at [[2007 World Championship]] (Day 2).

Deck title Sorry, DBO (Sorry, DBJ on inventory). SATM+BP → Sorry About The Mess combo. Sensible Route & Galactic Barrier may redlink. OOTA → Out Of That Anytime (uncertain). → [[Sorry About The Mess & •Blaster Proficiency]]. Tendar Braden → [[Tendau Bendon]]. OOTA shield → [[Out Of That Anytime]] uncertain.
